verdict.rationale: Terraform's docs show it has workspaces, each with its own state (docs-20, docs-35), and that HCP Terraform workspaces can be created and updated with their own variables (docs-56). Per-run variable files via -var-file (docs-46) can supply different values per environment, and a hands-on user reports managing dev/qa/prod infrastructure with Terraform (comm-1). However, none of the documentation explicitly describes setting up dev/staging/prod as separate workspaces or stacks, and one user complains of no phased workspaces even in commercial products (comm-10). Missing for 10: first-party docs on a per-environment workspace or stack workflow, CLI workspace commands, environment promotion between workspaces, and independent corroboration of the workspace-per-environment pattern.
